[[Mhedi's Vow]] is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Captain Mhedi]], a [[boss]] in [[Barbarous Shore]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]] 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]]: -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Embossed Scythe]].
